note: Official names and descriptions as PlayStation publishes them. Guides are written for this entry in its own words and cite their sources; no guide text is copied from another guide.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. There is no online trophy and no DLC is needed, so one single-player playthrough is enough. Play the story first at your own pace, then work the post-game cleanup with the in-game 100% checklist (Touch Pad, then Progress) open beside this tracker. The last gate for most hunters is A Long Road, the 100% completion gold.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist, which unlocks after the story (Touch Pad, then Progress, then 100% Completion). You do not need literally everything: 15 of the 18 collectible card sets count, and 70 of the 80 challenges. The checklist itself is the authority — open it in-game and clear one category at a time rather than guessing. Expect this to be the last trophy before the platinum for most players.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the last story mission and the trophy pops with the credits. It cannot be missed: the mission is part of the main story, and after the credits you keep free-roaming Leonida with everything still open. If you are hunting the platinum, treat the story as stage one and start the cleanup only once this has popped.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in Leonida: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. You only need about three-fifths of them, so pick the easy ones first — stunt jumps off ramps and bridges, then under-bridge gaps in a plane. Found stunts show on the map (Touch Pad, then Exploration, then Stunt Spots) and your count lives under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the two ranges: Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero. Most challenges have three difficulty tiers to clear, and some stay locked until you meet their conditions, which the map shows. Find the ranges under Touch Pad, then Activities, then Shooting Ranges, and work the easiest tiers first to learn each drill.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and get clean away after each one. Scout the vault first, bring a fast getaway car, and break line of sight before the wanted level climbs — losing the heat counts as the escape. The vaults are spread across Leonida, so this pairs naturally with exploring the map for The Goodtime State.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish eight stranger mission strands across Leonida. The named strands are Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret, each with its own bronze trophy for its final mission, plus further strands that count toward the eight. Strangers appear as question marks on the map as the story opens them up; clear each strand when it appears instead of saving them all for the end.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Finish any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets. Cards are found across Leonida; track them under Touch Pad, then Progress, then Collections, then Collectible Cards. Cards you sell at pawn shops still count toward your sets, so sell freely. You will need 15 sets for 100% completion anyway, so this trophy falls out of the cleanup naturally.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK locations with the WAiNK phone app (hold Up to open the phone). Scannable spots are landmarks (31), curiosities (35), sculptures (23) and No Flusher tags — more than 100 in total, so you can skip the awkward ones. Your count is under Touch Pad, then Progress, then Collections, then WAiNK Locations; scan whatever you pass while doing other trophies and the total climbs on its own.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish Gone Fishing, Jason's first mission, and the trophy pops as part of the story. It is the first trophy most players earn and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 of the story. The trophy pops as Chapter 2 begins, with its first mission, What's in the Bag? It is automatic and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2 of the story. The trophy is awarded as Chapter 3 opens, after the mission Welcome to Vice City. Automatic and unmissable.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 of the story. The trophy pops after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life. Automatic and unmissable.

trophies.name: Top of the World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 of the story. Like the other chapter trophies it pops on its own as the story moves on, and it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It is part of the main story, so just keep playing the campaign and it pops on its own.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. It is a main-story mission, so it pops naturally as you play through the campaign.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Another main-story trophy: keep playing the campaign and it unlocks by itself.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. It pops as part of the main story and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown at the airport. It is a main-story mission, so it unlocks as you play through the campaign.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It pops as part of the main story and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand; the trophy pops after his final mission. Andy's strand is found through the stranger marker on the map once the story opens it. Clear each of Andy's missions as they appear.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand; the trophy pops after his final mission, Maritime Disputes. Kenton's strand is one of the six named stranger strands that feed the Strangers & Freaks silver.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand; the trophy pops after his final mission, Hometown Heroes. Billy's strand counts toward the eight stranger strands for the silver.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand, which revolves around his vehicle wish list. Track the wish-list vehicles down as you explore and the strand moves forward; the trophy pops after Randy's final mission.

trophies.name: Spin on This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand, which involves the Kitty Litter Lab. Follow the strand's missions as they unlock and the trophy pops after Tyrone's final mission.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Take on Bret's hunting strand and bring down the unique animal he asks for. Hunting needs patience: track the animal, stay downwind, and take a clean shot. The trophy pops once the hunt is done.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types at least once: stunts, shooting ranges, drone races, races, fishing, arcade games, meditation, challenges and one more of the open-world pastimes the game counts. You only need to try each one, not master it, so sample everything early and this pops quickly.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Some charge an entry fee, so keep some cash aside. Learn each course's corners before pushing for the win, and check the discovered locations under Touch Pad, then Activities, then Drones, then Top Fun Drones.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — replays of the same race do not count. Race locations appear as you explore Leonida and are tracked under Touch Pad, then Activities, then Racing. Most spots let you hire a car; check its Rating first, and buy upgrades at Mod Shops if you bring your own.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Early on Cal asks you to catch a Parrotfish over 2kg: fish in the marked area from a boat with a rod until one of the right size bites. Any boat in the area can be borrowed if you do not own one yet.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Play an arcade game through to its end. Arcade machines are found in bars and amusement spots around Leonida — walk up to one and finish a full game. It is one of the quickest trophies on the list.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. THIS IS THE ONE MISSABLE TROPHY: one spot is at Jason's house and another is Lucia's balcony meditation, both only available in Chapter 1 — do them before the story moves on. A meditation only counts once the final zen animation has played. Track found spots under Touch Pad, then Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations, and on the map under Exploration, then Meditate Around Leonida.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 in-game challenges. Challenges are the game's own feat list, viewable under Touch Pad, then Progress, then Challenges. They range from combat feats to driving and exploration, so most complete themselves while you hunt other trophies. Note that 100% completion wants 70, so keep going past 50.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside, build a 4-star wanted level and then lose it completely. Get out of the cops' sight, break line of sight in alleys or water, and stay hidden until the stars clear. Doing it with your partner present is the requirement — the escape itself works like any other wanted-level escape.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in a row without ever losing your wanted level between them — keep the heat alive from the first shop to the third. Plan a route of three close shops, move fast, and do not let the stars clear or the chain breaks. A fast car parked outside each shop helps.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected at any point. Scout the store first, go in quiet, avoid the cameras and the staff's sightlines, and leave before anyone raises the alarm. Save before you start — if you are spotted, reload and try another approach.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks run set routes around Leonida — block one, crack it open, grab the cash and break away before the response arrives. A fast car and a planned escape route matter more than firepower.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang in Leonida. Each gang runs its own operations around the state; hit one per gang and the trophy pops. Keep a note of which gangs you have hit — the tracker on this page lets you mark it done only when every gang is covered.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a cumulative $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists; take them to your contacts to clean them, and the total adds up across the whole playthrough. Do not spend marked bills directly — only laundered money counts.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down five enemies during one single use of Combat Focus. Find a spot with a group of enemies, trigger Combat Focus, and chain the takedowns before it ends. Save first and pick a busy fight — a quiet street will not give you five targets in one window.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore every region of Leonida until the whole map is uncovered. Drive, fly and sail into each corner — Vice City, Port Gellhorn, the keys, the swamps and the mountains — and the trophy pops once no region is left unexplored. Pair it with stunts, WAiNK scans and vehicle discovery so the miles do triple duty.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. A vehicle counts as discovered when you get inside one or scan one, and the count climbs naturally through the story. Track it under Touch Pad, then Progress, then Vehicles. To finish it off, tour car parks, docks and airfields and hop into anything you have not driven yet.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all eight garage properties through the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone: Mitchel Auto Center ($4,000), 7th Avenue Garage ($12,000), Vela Rota Drive Garage ($24,000), Persistence Road Garage ($7,600), Wyatt Motors ($21,600), Bonita Court Garage ($34,000), Atlantic Court Garage ($40,000) and Store n' Bolt ($16,800) — $160,000 in total. Each adds one parking spot, which also helps On the Spot.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 different vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Register any vehicle you are driving at a Pay 'N' Spray or Mod Shop, as long as you have a free parking spot — the fee varies with the vehicle's value. Buy more garages from the Vice City Real Estate app if you run out of spots.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a cumulative $100,000 across all shops. Any shop counts and the total adds up over the whole playthrough, so just buy what you need — clothes, food, ammo, car upgrades — and it pops on its own. Find shops on the map under Touch Pad, then Style.

trophies.name: Catch Me if You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from Vice City International Airport — take an aircraft and leave without following any scheduled route. Steal a plane from the airfield and climb out over the city; the trophy pops once you are away. Expect a wanted level, so have an escape in mind.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get into a Rhino tank and make it through a hot situation in one — the trophy is tied to driving the tank while the heat is on. Find a Rhino at a military site, climb in, and survive the response that follows. Keep moving: a parked tank is a target.

trophies.name: In the Beginning...
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Head to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail at a beachfront spot and enjoy the view. It is a quiet moment trophy: no combat, no chase — just sit, drink and watch the ocean until it pops.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a vehicle straight through a showroom's glass front and out the other side, in classic style. Pick a showroom with a clear run-up, build speed, and smash through the window — the trophy pops on the exit. Expect a wanted level and a repair bill.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go to the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley and follow through on a full game. Bowl a complete game — the follow-through is the point — and the trophy pops at the end of it.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Max out strength with both Jason and Lucia. Work out with each protagonist until their strength stat is maxed — gyms and physical activities build it — and the trophy pops once both are at the top. Switch protagonists regularly so neither lags behind.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make a story choice and live with it. This trophy pops when you commit to one of the game's branching decisions — the choice itself is the unlock, for better or worse. There is no wrong pick for the trophy; pick the one that fits your playthrough.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Fail something once, then come back and nail it on the second try. This trophy is about the retry: attempt the moment, miss it, and succeed when you try again. If it does not pop, look for a scripted moment that invites a second attempt.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Trigger one of Leonida's strangest moments — the kind that makes you ask what just happened. These odd encounters are scattered around the map; explore the weird corners of the state and the trophy pops when you stumble into one.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl people over with a melee drive-by — strike from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon and send them flying like pins. Pick a busy sidewalk, build a little speed, and swing as you pass. It takes a few attempts to line up cleanly.
